page.title: Setup Guide
page.description: The complete, dependency-ordered flow for getting your school running — what to set up first, and why.
page.footer: Every screen mentioned above lives in the sidebar to the left, grouped the same way as this guide.

subdomainCard.title: Your school's own address
subdomainCard.descriptionBefore: Everything for your school happens at your own subdomain — you're on it right now:
subdomainCard.descriptionAfter: . Bookmark it. If you ever see login or "network" errors, the first thing to check is that you're on the right subdomain, not a bare central address.

academicYear.title: Academic Year
academicYear.description: Create the current year (e.g. "2025-2026") and mark it current. Only one year should be current at a time — students, sections, exams, and fees all default to it.

terms.title: Terms
terms.description: Split the year into grading periods. Exams and report cards are scoped to a term.

departments.title: Departments (optional)
departments.description: Group subjects for reporting, e.g. "Mathematics & Science".

gradeLevels.title: Grade Levels
gradeLevels.description: The ladder your school teaches — Kindergarten through your highest grade, each with a sequence number.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: Physical rooms with a capacity and type. Needed before Sections, since a section usually has a home room.

sections.title: Sections
sections.description: The actual classes students get admitted into.
sections.bold: You cannot admit a student until at least one section exists.

subjects.title: Subjects
subjects.description: What's taught — Mathematics, Science, English, and so on.

timetablePeriods.title: Timetable Periods
timetablePeriods.description: The daily schedule skeleton (Period 1, Break, Period 2, ...), shared across every section.

inviteStaff.title: Invite staff
inviteStaff.description: Name, email, and a role — the role decides what they can do. See the Roles tab for the full breakdown.

designations.title: Designations
designations.description: Job titles like "Teacher" or "Vice Principal" — attach one to each staff member (with an employee ID and hire date) if you plan to use payroll later.

classTeachers.title: Class Teachers
classTeachers.description: Assign one staff member per section as its Class Teacher, distinct from subject teachers.

assignments.title: Class–Subject–Teacher assignments
assignments.description: For each section, decide which teacher teaches which subject — this is what makes "my classes" show up correctly for a Teacher/Class Teacher, and what exam-mark-entry and homework screens use to know who's allowed to grade what.

timetableEntries.title: Timetable entries
timetableEntries.description: Place each (section, subject, teacher) into an actual day/period/room slot. One entry per section+period+day — the system won't let you double-book a section's same period on the same day.

admitStudents.title: Admit students
admitStudents.description: Name, gender, date of birth, grade level, and section (must already exist). Admission automatically generates an admission number and records enrollment history.

addGuardians.title: Add guardians
addGuardians.description: Link a father/mother/guardian to each student, with one marked primary. Invite a guardian to give them a Parent login — they'll see their child's attendance, grades, invoices, and homework.

nothingToConfigure.title: Nothing to configure
nothingToConfigure.description: Go to Take Attendance, pick a section and date, mark each student present / absent / late / half-day / excused / on-leave. Staff Attendance works the same way.

gradingScale.title: Grading Scale + Bands
gradingScale.description: Define percentage ranges and their letter grades (A: 90–100, B: 80–89, ...). Mark one scale default — any exam subject that doesn't specify its own scale falls back to it.

exams.title: Exams
exams.description: Name, academic year, term, and a weight (used when averaging multiple exams into a final grade).

examSubjects.title: Exam Subjects
examSubjects.description: Which (subject, section) pairs are actually being tested, with max/passing marks and a date. An exam with no Exam Subject for a student's section won't show up for that student at all.

enterPublishMarks.title: Enter & publish marks
enterPublishMarks.description: Marks entry opens once an exam subject exists. Publish when ready — students/parents can't see marks until then.

createHomework.title: Create homework
createHomework.description: Section, subject, teacher, due date, and max score. Submissions and grading happen per-student after.

phase8.title: Phase 8 — Fees & Billing (your school billing its students)

feeCategories.title: Fee Categories
feeCategories.description: Tuition, Transport, Library, Examination, and so on.

feeStructures.title: Fee Structures
feeStructures.description: Attach an amount and frequency to a category for the current year, optionally per grade level.

feeAssignments.title: Student Fee Assignments (optional)
feeAssignments.description: A per-student discount (percentage or fixed) against a fee structure — e.g. a sibling discount.
feeAssignments.bold: Set this up before generating that student's invoice

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.description: Generate per-student, pulling in the relevant fee structures and any discount as line items.

payments.title: Payments & Credit Notes
payments.description: Record money received (cash, cheque, bank transfer, UPI, card) — the invoice's status updates automatically. Issue a credit note for partial adjustments without altering the original invoice.

subscriptionCard.title: Phase 15 — Your own subscription
subscriptionCard.subtitle: This is separate from Phase 8 — it's what this platform charges your school, not what your school charges parents.
subscriptionCard.description: Under Settings → Billing you can see your current plan, trial end date, and usage against your plan's student/staff limits, and change plans. Creating a new staff user past your plan's limit returns a clear "plan limit reached" error rather than silently succeeding.

addBooks.title: Add books
addBooks.description: Title, author, ISBN, category, and copy count.

issueReturn.title: Issue & return
issueReturn.description: Issue a copy to a student or staff member, then return it later. Fines (if any) are computed automatically from your Library fine settings, and available-copy counts adjust on issue/return.

vehiclesRoutes.title: Vehicles and Routes
vehiclesRoutes.description: Set up in either order — registration/driver details for vehicles, ordered stops for each route.

studentAssignments.title: Student Assignments
studentAssignments.description: Link a student to a route, stop, and vehicle. A student can only have one active assignment — assigning a new one automatically closes out the old one.

hostels.title: Hostels
hostels.description: Boys / Girls / Mixed, each with a warden.

allocations.title: Allocations
allocations.description: Assign a student to a room + bed. Allocating past a room's capacity is rejected — vacate an existing allocation to free a bed first.

salaryStructures.title: Salary Structures
salaryStructures.description: Basic salary, allowances, deductions per staff member. Only one active structure per person — a new one automatically supersedes the old.

payslips.title: Payslips
payslips.description: Generate for a month/year — this snapshots the currently-active salary structure's numbers, so later salary changes don't rewrite old payslips.

leaveTypes.title: Leave Types & Requests
leaveTypes.description: Define leave types (Casual, Sick, Earned, Unpaid) with an annual allowance. Staff apply, HR/Admin reviews. Approving a leave request automatically marks matching staff-attendance rows "on leave" for that date range — no need to mark attendance separately.

templates.title: Templates
templates.description: Write a reusable body with placeholders:

issue.title: Issue
issue.description: Issue against a specific student — placeholders are interpolated and permanently snapshotted, so editing the template later never changes certificates already issued.

noticeBoard.title: Notice Board
noticeBoard.description: General notices or dated events, targeted at everyone / students / staff / parents, with an optional expiry.

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.description: A broadcast that also creates an in-app notification for every matching recipient, delivered live via the notification bell where real-time delivery is configured — otherwise recipients still get it on their next automatic refresh.

studentRemarks.title: Student Remarks
studentRemarks.description: A teacher can leave academic, behavioral, or general notes on a student, optionally visible to that student's guardians.

roles.intro: A user can hold more than one role if your org chart doesn't map cleanly onto one of these — e.g. a Vice Principal who also teaches.

schoolAdmin.access: Everything — users, roles, settings, billing, all modules

principal.access: Read-heavy across the board, manages academics/timetable/exams, no billing

accountant.access: Fee categories/structures, invoices, payments, credit notes

hrStaff.access: Users, designations, leave, payroll, staff attendance

teacher.access: Their own classes: attendance, exam marks, homework, remarks

classTeacher.access: Everything Teacher has, plus attendance export and section-wide remarks

student.access: Read-only: own timetable, attendance, grades, homework, invoices, certificates

parent.access: Same as Student, scoped to their linked children

wrongSubdomain.q: "Network error" or CORS-looking errors right after signing in.
wrongSubdomain.a: You're very likely on the wrong address — it must be your own {{slug}} subdomain, never a bare central address. Re-check the URL bar.

tooManyAttempts.a: A short-lived safety limit on repeated login tries (protects against password guessing). It clears on its own within a minute — wait and try again rather than retrying rapidly.

emptyDropdown.q: A dropdown has no options in it.
emptyDropdown.a: That almost always means an earlier setup phase is missing — e.g. the Student form's Section dropdown is empty because no Section has been created yet. Check the phase before the one you're on.

discountNotShowing.q: A discount I set up isn't showing on an invoice.
discountNotShowing.a: Student Fee Assignment discounts only apply to invoices generated after the discount was created — they never apply retroactively to an existing invoice.

recordDisappeared.q: I created a new transport assignment / hostel allocation / salary structure and the old one disappeared.
recordDisappeared.a: That's expected — these all follow a "one active record per person" rule, enforced by automatically closing out the previous one rather than blocking the new one.
